faqs.q: How does the versioning system handle offline changes?
faqs.a: SiteFlow queues markups and approvals made on the mobile app while offline. Once connectivity returns, changes sync and any overlapping annotations are flagged for administrator review.

faqs.q: Can we restrict viewing permissions by subcontractor?
faqs.a: Yes. Design Management integrates with SiteFlow's role-based access control, so you can restrict drawing sets by discipline, zone, or specific subcontractor entity, ensuring trade partners see only the blueprints relevant to their scope.

faqs.q: What file formats are supported for the markup engine?
faqs.a: Drawings can be ingested as PDF with vector preservation for clean zoom, plus common image formats for field sketches. Markups and RFIs attach directly to the drawing in the viewer.
